'''Temmin Vyn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] who spoke out against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As a result, the Empire took him into custody, claiming that it was for his own protection, and carried him aboard the convoy known as [[Perlemian Haul]].<ref name="PH" />
